sloka: ततो मरुत्तो नृपतिः को भवानित्युवाच तम् ।अपहासं ततो मुक्त्वा रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ७.१८.८ ॥
transliteration: tato marutto nṛpatiḥ ko bhavānityuvāca tam ।apahāsaṁ tato muktvā rāvaṇo vākyamabravīt ।। 7.18.8 ॥

translations.english: Then King Marutta asked him, "Who are you?", whereupon Ravana, letting out a scornful laugh, spoke these words.
